children.value: This repo is integrated with workflow tools like
to make complex molecular simulation workflows easy. You can use any MLP recipe (relaxations, single-points, elastic calculations, etc.) and simply specify the

One of the nice things about QuAcc is that you can use plugins for whatever your favorite workflow engine is (Fireworks, Parsl, Prefect, etc.). Some of these methods can scale to hundreds of thousands of parallel calculations and are used by the FAIR chemistry team regularly!
Below is an example that uses the default

from __future__ import annotations

from ase.build import bulk
from quacc.recipes.mlp.elastic import elastic_tensor_flow

# Make an Atoms object of a bulk Cu structure
atoms = bulk("Cu")

# Run an elastic property calculation with our favorite MLP potential
result = elastic_tensor_flow(
    atoms,
    job_params={
        "all": dict(
            method="fairchem",
            name_or_path="uma-s-1p2",
            task_name="omat",
        ),
    },
)
